Coop Dreams

Back to quest database

Quick answer

Community label for the early chicken-purchase objective; the exact in-game tracker title is not retained.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Objectives and actionable steps

  1. Collect 15 stone.
  2. Collect 20 wood logs.
  3. Collect 15 hay.
  4. Have at least 5,760 C available.
  5. Buy the coop blueprint from Meriam.
  6. Finish building the coop.
  7. Visit Angela's ranch.
  8. Buy at least two hens; this check requires female chickens.
  9. Put two hens in the coop; ownership alone is not enough.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • 5,760 C is a funds threshold, not a verified blueprint price or shopping total.
  • The overview mentions a rooster, but purchase and housing checks specifically require two hens.

Failure, recovery and continuation

Failure trigger
No quest-level failure trigger recorded
How to recover after failure
Restarts the current quest
After success
Starts a configured follow-up call

Configuration records, sources and evidence boundary

Configuration records are not individual runtime tests; the sources below retain their original evidence levels and builds.

  • Players complete the purchase step through Angela, the chicken seller. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken coop mission · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Bought chickens spawn in the fenced field behind her house instead of entering inventory; grab them and use a car boot or carry them home. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken coop mission · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Every retained stuck case came from missing the post-purchase prompt, but that pattern does not rule out other mission bugs. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken coop mission · Build: 0.8.10.x

These steps come from the recorded game build and public sources; missing rewards, prerequisites and unlock timing are not filled in.
